sub_limits_waiting_notes: Group umbrella policy with 49 modular sections combining Personal Accident, Critical Illness, Cancer, Hospitalization, Maternity, OPD, Card/Wallet/Identity Theft and Wellness covers. Specific waiting periods per section.

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Section 26 Hospitalization Cover; up to Sum Insured per schedule.

day_care_treatments.notes: All listed day care procedures covered.

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Section 38 — home hospitalization > 3 days, listed chronic conditions excluded.

ayush_coverage.notes: Section 30 Alternate Treatment (AYUSH) — inpatient AYUSH treatment in NABH/NQAS-certified hospital.

maternity_coverage.notes: Sections 33-35: maternity benefit, newborn baby cover, miscarriage due to accident; 9-month waiting period.

newborn_coverage.notes: Section 33 — newborn baby cover linked to maternity benefit.

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Section 29 — donor harvesting expenses plus 5% donor pre/post-hospitalisation.

ambulance_cover.notes: Road ambulance and Section 31 Emergency Air Ambulance (within India only).

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Sections 19/20/21 — CI benefit, CI hospitalisation, CI hospitalisation cash allowance covers; Sections 22/23 Cancer benefit and cancer hospitalisation.

preventive_health_checkup.notes: Section 40 Wellness Benefit Programme + complimentary check-up.

permanent_exclusions: Hazardous adventure sports (unless Adventure Sports Cover opted)
notable_exclusions_summary: Group umbrella policy with 49 modular sections — Personal Accident, Critical Illness, Cancer, comprehensive Hospitalization, Maternity, OPD, plus Cards/Wallet/Identity Theft/Purchase Protection. Optional Adventure Sports and HIV covers reduce standard exclusions.
claim_process_summary: 1800-258-4242 / healthclaims@godigit.com. Digital claim intimation through portal/app.
